task.title: Register Phase L milestone L10 Deterministic DOM Intelligence (Scrapling), planning only
task.objective: Planning and registration only. File one open milestone child under the open Phase L epic awkit-djnl: L10 Deterministic DOM Intelligence (Scrapling), with its eight workstreams L10.0-L10.7 held in docs/plans/ai-upgrade-v5/L10-deterministic-dom-intelligence.md, following the one-bead-per-milestone convention of L8a/L8b/L9. Blocks edges: L10 after closed L3 (awkit-djnl.4), closed L5a (awkit-djnl.7) and closed L7 (awkit-djnl.10); no edge to L9 or to the open follow-up awkit-djnl.15. Record the reopen rule on the epic notes. Refresh .beads/issues.jsonl with bd export -o. No existing bead changes status; awkit-djnl.15 and the epic stay open. The plan documents, docs/ai narrative, src/roadmap/ImplementationRoadmap.ts and the verifier pins are ordinary unleased direct-loop edits made after this lease is released. No Scrapling, Python runtime, host, locator, normalization, UI or packaging behavior is implemented.

acceptance.description: The Phase L epic stays open with one new open milestone child L10 (awkit-djnl.18) whose blocks edges are exactly closed L3 awkit-djnl.4, closed L5a awkit-djnl.7 and closed L7 awkit-djnl.10. Every other child keeps its status: the thirteen milestones and .14, .16, .17 closed, .15 open.
.beads/issues.jsonl is refreshed with bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl, and verify:roadmap-dashboard passes with Sources agree after its pins move to measured values.
